evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Provide usage examples for every top-level main workflow schema property.
intent.acceptance: Partial facet: a property occurs as a root frontmatter key in at least one structurally Draft-7-valid standalone workflow/demo, using the main schema at the same immutable revision. Format annotations, compiler semantics and imported partial fragments remain separate.

evidence.opportunity: All top-level schema properties and Markdown files under .github/workflows/ and schema-demos/ at each immutable state.
filters: Parse actual root YAML frontmatter, not prose, nested keys or fenced examples.
Only main-schema-valid standalone documents supply coverage. Imported fragments lacking a trigger do not qualify for this partial facet.
The pinned independent Draft-7 validator never retrieves remote references or treats format annotations as assertions.
Invalid YAML and schema-invalid examples are recorded and cannot supply property credit.
Repository coverage is a state, not fresh weekly delivery, compiler acceptance or workflow causation.
evidence.collection: Replay digest-checked native validations from immutable Git snapshots; acquisition uses YAML 2.9 and jsonschema 4.23.0.

model.architecture: Independent structural schema validation and root-key set coverage.
model.recommendation: Review native example coverage separately from compiler acceptance, attribution and costs.

presentation.label: Validated schema usage
presentation.betterLabel: Fewer properties without a validated standalone example

summary.nativeLabel: Schema properties without validated standalone usage

metrics.name: Properties without structurally valid standalone usage
metrics.formula: current schema properties minus the union of validated root-key usages

metrics.name: Properties with structurally valid standalone usage
metrics.formula: distinct schema properties in validated standalone root frontmatter

metrics.name: Validated standalone schema coverage
metrics.formula: covered properties * 100 / current schema property population
